_comment: Certified KPIs. Each is defined once here, implemented by its certified views in sql/semantic/ and checked by run_semantic.py --steps kpi_check; scripts/governance.py publishes each as a term of the EVX Data Products glossary. TTC is added with the uc01 worklist (phase 7).

kpis.name: Cell first-pass yield
kpis.definition: Share of graded cells that pass first time: not graded REJECT and no X-ray FAIL. Cells are not reworked, so the first pass is the only pass. Cells whose process start is not loaded are left out.
kpis.grain: production day (IST, starting with shift A) x cell line x shift x formation station

kpis.name: Pack first-pass yield
kpis.definition: Share of packs that pass the pack end-of-line test first time.
kpis.grain: production day x pack line x shift x wire-bond station

kpis.name: Field incident rate within 90 days
kpis.definition: Vehicles with a battery-related warranty claim (resolved to the VIN through master.xref) failing within 90 days of entering service, per 1,000 vehicles that have been in service 90 days by the data's as-of date. In service from delivery, else vehicle EOL.
kpis.grain: build week of vehicle EOL; supplier batch (majority cathode powder lot of the pack fitted at EOL)
